name: Spooky Scary Skeletons AI Dance: You as the Vampire Under the Orange Moon
blurb: The Spooky Scary Skeletons AI dance is the October 2026 TikTok edit where a character in a black vampire cape dances in front of an orange full moon, with bats and jack-o'-lanterns, to "Spooky, Scary Skeletons".

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same huge glowing orange full moon in a deep red-orange sky, the black bats, the bare twisted trees, the gravestones on the dark hill and the glowing jack-o'-lanterns, the same low fixed camera, the same framing, timing and dance moves. The ONLY change: the vampire's face and hair are now the face and hair of the person in [Image 1].

The vampire = the person in [Image 1], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] - face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. The same real person in every frame, from the first second to the last, so their friends instantly recognize them, also when the arms and the cape swing up. Whether the person in [Image 1] is a man or a woman, the face is theirs. Never morph, never drift back to the original vampire's face, never add or remove facial hair. NO combed-back dark-brown hair unless [Image 1] shows it. They wear the vampire's costume from the video, never the clothes from [Image 1]: the fitted black Victorian suit, the white shirt, the black bow tie, the grey-white waistcoat, the black trousers, the polished black shoes and the flowing black cape with the tall pointed collar and the burgundy-red lining.

The dance, matching the reference second by second:
0-1.5 s: bounces on the spot with the arms held out low to the sides, then stands tall.
1.5-3.5 s: kicks one foot out to the side, then the other, elbows bent.
3.5-5.5 s: throws both arms out wide, so the cape opens like wings, and lifts the knees in turn.
5.5-8.5 s: twists the hips left and right with quick little kicks, arms close to the body.
8.5-10 s: a hop with the hands up by the shoulders, then one arm thrown up high and one knee up for the final pose.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the dancer's shoulders. Two arms and two hands, no extra limbs, even in the fastest moves. No fangs, no blood. No text, no logos, no watermark, no other people.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Kling 3.0 Omni, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Replace the vampire in the video with the pet in the first image. The man from the video must not appear in any frame. Keep the original actions, poses, body movements, camera movement, background, lighting and timing. Only replace the vampire and keep everything else unchanged.

The pet stands upright on its hind legs in the vampire's place and does the same dance. It is the same species and breed as the pet in the first image, with the same face, eyes, ears, muzzle, fur colours, fur length and markings, its own furry paws and its own tail, with the natural body volume of that animal: never a human face, human hands or human skin. It wears the dramatic, flowing black vampire cape with a tall, pointed collar and deep burgundy-red lining from the video, spreading outward from the shoulders in elegant folds, and a black bow tie at the neck. No suit, no trousers and no shoes on the pet.

Timing, second by second, as in the original video:
0-1.5 s: bounces on the spot with the front legs held out low to the sides, then stands tall.
1.5-3.5 s: kicks one hind foot out to the side, then the other.
3.5-5.5 s: throws both front legs out wide, so the cape opens like wings, and lifts the knees in turn.
5.5-8.5 s: twists the hips left and right with quick little kicks.
8.5-10 s: a hop, then one front paw thrown up high for the final pose.

The orange full moon, the bats, the bare trees, the gravestones and the glowing jack-o'-lanterns stay exactly as in the video. The pet keeps its own look from the first image in every frame. One animal only and no person anywhere in the frame. No fangs, no blood, no text, no logos, no watermark, no extra people or animals.
